headline: 便當失竊！公司冰箱淪陷
ticker: 神祕筷手入侵｜午餐主權告急｜最後一塊肉失守
anchor_script: 插播！公司冰箱爆發便當主權危機！受害員工中午開門，只見空盒，滷汁都遭清場！涉案同事嘴角油亮，竟辯稱是在替雞腿進行安全檢測！現場飯粒散落，茶水間全面封鎖！虛構午餐保衛隊緊急出動，拿鍋蓋築起防線！一顆滷蛋能否追回？最後一口白飯究竟流向何方？全國上班族，筷子握緊！

shots.scene_en: In an unmarked office kitchenette, an unsuspecting employee lovingly places a plain lunch box inside the refrigerator in a low-angle close-up, with no visible text, letters, or logos.
In the same kitchenette, a sneaky coworker tiptoes toward the open refrigerator while clutching chopsticks like tiny burglar tools in a wide shot, with no visible text, letters, or logos.
At a bare office counter, the coworker gleefully devours a chicken leg as rice grains tumble onto the surface in an extreme close-up, with no visible text, letters, or logos.
Beside the open refrigerator, the returning employee discovers the empty lunch box and drops dramatically to their knees in a tilted medium shot, with no visible text, letters, or logos.

In the kitchenette, the oily-mouthed coworker solemnly examines a remaining braised egg through a magnifying glass while the employee points accusingly in an over-the-shoulder shot, with no visible text, letters, or logos.

Across the office kitchenette, a ridiculous lunch defense squad crouches behind plain pot lids while the braised egg rolls between them in a floor-level wide shot, with no visible text, letters, or logos.
